title: Senior Director - Marketing, JioHotstar (South)
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strategic Marketing & Growth Identify growth opportunities across user lifecycle
- acquisition, retention and engagement Analyze consumer behaviour, user journeys and audience cohorts to uncover opportunities to deepen engagement and grow Watch Time. Design and drive campaigns, interventions and special projects that deliver measurable outcomes across markets and consumer segments. Build repeatable marketing frameworks that support long-term growth objectives. Digital & Performance Marketing Hands-on experience in running and optimizing large-scale marketing campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google and other digital ecosystems. Partner with platform marketing and media teams to unlock opportunities across acquisition, engagement and retention Stay ahead of evolving industry trends and best practices across performance marketing, social media and consumer engagement. Recommend and implement new approaches to improve marketing effectiveness, efficiency and ROI. Data & Consumer Insights Leverage platform data, campaign metrics and consumer insights to drive both marketing and creative decisions-from audience targeting to messaging and content positioning. Drive a culture of experimentation through structured testing, including A/B testing of creatives, messaging, audience cohorts and campaign approaches. AI & Marketing Innovation Stay ahead of emerging AI-led marketing practices and identify opportunities to apply them within the business. Champion the adoption of tools, technologies and ways of working that improve productivity, effectiveness and consumer impact. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Content, Strategy, Product, Analytics, Platform Marketing & Business teams to drive initiatives from idea to execution Influence stakeholders across teams and markets to align on priorities, timelines and deliver outcomes. Drive problem-solving and ensure progress on strategic initiatives that require cross-functional collaboration. Candidate Profile 10-12 years of experience in Marketing, Growth, Consumer Marketing or Digital Marketing roles. Experience in industries such as E-commerce, OTT, FMCG, Consumer Internet, Digital-first businesses or Technology platforms. Brings a data-led and digital-first perspective to marketing decision-making. Strong understanding of digital marketing, performance marketing and social media ecosystems. Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive outcomes in matrixed organizations High ownership, strong problem-solving ability and outcome-oriented mindset. Curious, adaptable and passionate about the evolving intersection of creative, marketing, technology and consumer behaviour. Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, Jio Star is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. Jio Star India Private Limited (formerly known as Star India Private Limited) is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. title: Assistant Manager- Content Regulation, Telugu
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES Vet and review all short-form and long-form content (including acquired and original shows, films, promos, clips, commercials, and social media assets) from a content compliance and risk perspective. Proactively identify and flag potential violations of OTT and Broadcast compliance codes, internal policies, government and regulatory guidelines, and applicable legal frameworks. Safeguard the brand by highlighting risks related to defamation, copyright, trademark, reputational concerns, and other compliance sensitivities. Collaborate on a day-to-day basis with cross-functional stakeholders including Content, Marketing, Operations, Legal, and Business teams to ensure smooth and timely compliance clearance. Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Indian content regulations and codes applicable to digital and television content (OTT guidelines, BCCC, CBFC, ASCI, etc.). QUALIFICATION Experience: 4-7 years of relevant work experience. Preferred Background: Candidates with experience in S&P/Content Compliance, Entertainment Content, or Programming are strongly preferred. (Priority will be given to profiles from existing GEC or OTT S&P teams) Profiles from content writing, editing, Journalism, translators, development, or marketing may be considered, provided they have a strong media and compliance orientation.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Media, History, Sociology, Literature, or a related discipline (Preferred, but not mandatory) KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Strong command over English and Telugu (written and spoken); working knowledge of Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada, or Tamil is an added advantage. Sound understanding of Indian socio-political, religious, and cultural landscapes. Sensitivity to local customs, social issues, and human-interest subjects. Strong communication, articulation, and presentation skills. Ability to interpret content risks clearly and convey feedback in a balanced, solution-oriented manner PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, Jio Star is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. title: Architect - Data Platform
jobDescription:

You will lead the design of scalable, reliable, and high-performance data systems that power analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and business decision-making at massive scale. About the Team: This is an opportunity to build foundational platforms that operate at internet scale and influence experiences for millions of users every day. You’ll join a team that values clarity over complexity, ownership over bureaucracy, and continuous learning over ego. We move fast, solve meaningful problems, and invest deeply in engineering excellence, collaboration, and innovation. Key

culture Encourage experimentation and rapid prototyping to accelerate innovation and reduce ambiguity Skills & Attributes for Success: Proven experience architecting and scaling large-scale distributed systems and data platforms Strong ownership mindset with a track record of leading critical initiatives from conception to production Excellent business acumen and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical decisions to business impact Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities with a bias toward simplicity and execution Deep expertise in software engineering fundamentals, system design, and performance optimization Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, distributed computing, and modern backend technologies Experience building high-throughput, low-latency, and highly available systems Ability to mentor and influence teams while fostering a collaborative and inclusive engineering culture Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with evolving priorities Growth-oriented mindset with a passion for learning, innovation, and engineering excellence

PREFERRED

title: Senior Content Designer
jobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY: As a Senior UX Writer / Content Designer, you will set up, drive, and own the vision for product language across Jio Hotstar’s consumer and enterprise platforms. You will shape communication across user journeys, craft copy systems that scale, and ensure every word delivers clarity, consistency, and brand personality. Beyond writing, you will define and evolve systemic frameworks: from voice and tone guidelines to terminology libraries and partner with cross-functional teams to make language a strategic lever for product and brand. Your work will ensure that Jio Hotstar feels world-class: clean, legible, intuitive, and human across mobile, TV, web, and enterprise experiences. ABOUT THE TEAM: Design is one of the key teams at Jio Hotstar. We have 4 key areas of focus
- Product Design, UX Research, Design Standards and Creative Studio. We are a closely-knit team of 30+ people at the moment, who work across the spectrum of design from deriving insight from data, designing interfaces and prototypes, and testing with users to motion graphics and illustrations KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Set up and own the vision for UX writing across all aspects of the product — shaping how users experience and understand Jio Hotstar Collaborate with design peers and stakeholders to craft in-app content and product messaging that is flawless, uniform, and concise Develop and refine writing systems — style guides, terminology, word lists, and strategy principles; while identifying and closing documentation gaps Elevate the interface by ensuring copy contributes to making Jio Hotstar apps world-class: clean, legible, intuitive, and delightful Champion user-centric content by applying structured, creative, and critical thinking to see from the user’s perspective and incorporate feedback Lead and mentor peers in content design, setting standards for consistency, quality, and scalability Leverage AI and content tools thoughtfully to scale copy workflows, accelerate exploration, and ensure efficiency without compromising craft SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS: Strong writing fundamentals — mastery of brevity, clarity, tone, and storytelling, with the ability to adapt voice across diverse surfaces and contexts Systems thinker — experience building or contributing to scalable content frameworks (voice and tone, terminology, reusable patterns, error/notification libraries) User-first mindset — ability to empathize with user needs, translate feedback into copy decisions, and champion accessibility and inclusivity in language Strategic collaborator — proven ability to influence and align with cross-functional teams (design, product, engineering, brand, marketing) at multiple levels Communication & leadership — strong articulation, facilitation, and storytelling skills; able to mentor peers, guide teams, and build org-wide confidence in language systems Adaptability with tools — comfort working in Figma and content ops workflows; familiarity with AI-assisted writing and automation tools to scale exploration and delivery PREFERRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 5–8 years of professional experience in UX writing, content design, or related fields, with a portfolio that demonstrates clarity, craft, storytelling, and strategic impact in digital products. title: Architect - Viewer experience
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As an Architect in the Foundations Org at Jio Hotstar, you will define the long-term technical vision and lead the evolution of core platforms, including the server-guided UI orchestration system. You’ll dive deep into challenges of scale and speed that directly impact video viewer funnel conversions and reach, helping make Jio Hotstar ubiquitous. This role involves designing scalable, fault-tolerant, and cost-efficient systems for massive and unpredictable LIVE traffic, collaborating closely with engineering, product, and data teams, and mentoring engineers while driving architectural excellence across the organization. About the team: At Jio Hotstar, the Viewer Experience org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end-to-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalization, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. title: Senior Director - Content Marketing, Star Plus
jobDescription:

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobDescription:
Location: Onsite, Bangalore Work Type: Full time Job Summary: As a Senior engineer, you’ll build a world-class content viewing experience for our customers by solving complex technical problems and building systems which run at an enormous scale. The role is expected to design and deliver high-quality distributed applications and also keep an extremely high operational excellence bar to provide a seamless experience to our customers on the Jio Hotstar website and TV applications. About the team: Jio Star’s Ad Platform is among the top video advertising platforms in India
- and we’re aiming higher. With deep expertise across Video-On-Demand, Live Sports, and Ad Monetization, our vision is to build the most effective and scalable adtech ecosystem in the world. Our engineering team builds across the full adtech stack
- from high-throughput backend services to deeply integrated, high-impact ad experiences on client platforms. Name a technology, and chances are we’ve worked with it. But more than the tools, it’s the problems we solve that make the work exciting. If you’re excited about building fast, learning continuously, and working on a product that sits at the center of content, monetization, and user experience, we’d love to talk. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
You will improve and add to our ever growing bucket of mind blowing features as an owner Collaborate with stakeholders of the product to deliver new user-facing features on the website/app You will ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and implement them Own and lead a feature through design to delivery Build reusable code and cross-functional libraries in contributing to our extensive in-house Design system. Review code and uphold coding standards You will document and demonstrate solutions by creating documentation, DFDs, code comments Support and mentor software engineers by providing advice, coaching and educational opportunities You will be responsible for making Jio Hotstar available in devices with constrained memory and network by continuous optimisations and pushing the web forward Skills and attributes for success: Strong experience in HTML, CSS and Javascript Deep knowledge about how browsers work Deep understanding about design & architecture patterns Highly enthusiastic and enjoy learning new technologies and frameworks You know why a framework is necessary and should have a strong command on modern frameworks, tools and libraries Open source contribution is good to have Proficient understanding of code versioning tools Git Prior experience collaborating with external vendors is preferred. Preferred education and experience: Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or a related field with 4-7 years of professional experience as a frontend developer with hands-on experience on Javascript. title: Director Product Management - Viewer Experience
jobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY: As a Director of Product Management, you will shape the product strategy and development to enhance customer engagement for the Platform charter in the Viewer experience team. You will establish a clear vision, create a roadmap for success, and nurture a high-performing product organization focused on innovation and customer satisfaction. The goal is to architect a hyper-scale, intelligent platform backbone that ensures flawless content delivery at scale and harnesses AI-driven video comprehension to unlock next-gen streaming experiences, serving as an adaptable foundation for future media innovations and evolving user behaviors. This role involves overseeing a dynamic team of product managers and providing strategic direction to a cross-functional group of engineers, designers, data scientists, and specialists. ABOUT THE TEAM: At Jio Hotstar, we're on a mission to deliver delightful experiences to our 500+ million customers across the globe. Our technology spans 25+ countries, with more on the horizon. The Viewer Experience (VX) org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end-to-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalisation, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. We blend world-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalized, and engaging OTT experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building immersive, intelligent, and performant user experiences that delight a billion users, join us in shaping the future of streaming. KEY

title: Software Development Engineer II (Web) - VX
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As a Software Development Engineer II, you’ll build a world-class content viewing experience for our customers by solving complex technical problems and building systems which run at an enormous scale. The role is expected to design and deliver high-quality distributed applications and also keep an extremely high operational excellence bar to provide a seamless experience to our customers on the Jio Hotstar website and TV applications. About the team: At Jio Hotstar, the Viewer Experience (VX) org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end-to-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalization, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. We blend world-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalized, and engaging OTT experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building immersive, intelligent, and performant user experiences that delight a billion users, join us in shaping the future of streaming. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own and deliver end-to-end features, ensuring high performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility Collaborate with stakeholders of the product to deliver new user-facing features on the website/TV app You will ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and implement them You will build reusable code and cross-functional libraries in contributing to our extensive in-house Design system Document and demonstrate solutions by creating documentation, DFDs, code comments Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using best practices and participate in code reviews Skills and attributes for success: Strong experience in Java Script Deep knowledge about how browsers work Deep understanding about design & architecture patterns Highly enthusiastic and enjoy learning new technologies and frameworks You know why a framework is necessary and know any of React, Angular JS etc Open source contribution is good to have Proficient understanding of code versioning tools Git Familiarity with front-end build tools, such as Grunt or Gulp Preferred education and experience: Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or a related field with 2-4 years of professional experience as a frontend developer with hands-on experience on Javascript. title: Manager - Digital Marketing, Digital
jobDescription:
Job Description – Manager, Content Commerce Department: Off-Platform Marketing Location: Mumbai Role Overview Jio Hotstar is seeking a high-caliber, strategic thinker to lead our pioneering Content Commerce ecosystem. Content commerce is our vision to bring digital entertainment and instant shopping together. Instead of making users leave the app to buy something, we are building a seamless experience where they can interact and make purchases—like ordering food—directly within the Jio Hotstar interface while watching their favorite content. As the Manager for Content Commerce, you will be the central owner driving user adoption, engagement, and business growth for these integrated experiences. Responsibilities Content Commerce includes integration of multi-category product purchase destinations within our streaming app. This role requires project management across multiple internal/external stakeholders like On-platform, Digital, Comms, Analytics, Product, etc to ensure targets are met This role requires a strong basic understanding of broader marketing levers, so as to build a cohesive GTM for every new integration. It also requires extensive experience in Off-platform/Digital marketing. Off Platform lever involves setting overall performance strategy based on success metrics such as views, conversion, ROI, with a strong focus on measurable outcomes. It involves working closely with internal stakeholders including Media agencies, Publishers, Analytics, Product, Content, and Comms to improve targeting, tracking, attribution, and optimization frameworks Experience & Skillset 5–6 years of professional experience, especially in digital marketing Strong experience in ROI-driven or lead-based businesses, preferably within consumer tech, media, or app-led ecosystems Hands-on experience managing large-scale digital marketing budgets Exposure to running campaigns using both first-party and third-party data Working knowledge of analytics, attribution, and measurement tools (e.g., Apps Flyer, DCM, or equivalent) Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and build scalable frameworks for a new and evolving business line Highly proficient in translating complex campaign strategies and performance reports into clear, compelling presentations (slide decks) and detailed planning documents for leadership and cross-functional teams. Experience in funnel analytics
- candidates must have experience in conducting platform deepdives, identifying drop offs, transactional behaviours & help in crafting retention strategies (using on-platform and off-platform techniques) Our Culture & Benefits Our Culture: We are customer-obsessed, audacious in our vision, and encourage open dialogue. We believe trust and accountability go hand-in-hand, and we invest heavily in each other's growth. Perks: Unlimited leave, a progressive work-life philosophy, no dress code, and a front-row seat on our rocket ship to redefine the future of entertainment and commerce! title: Director - Public Relations, English Cluster
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the PR strategy for the International Shows category from brief to execution, across the full slate and all tentpole moments through the year. Build and deepen relationships with the publications and journalists that matter for this category, with a focus on premium print, digital, and cultural media rather than just volume coverage. Lead launch campaigns for priority titles including press screenings, critic previews, media roundtables, and talent interactions coordinated with international studios and distributors. Internalise the messaging framework, tone for the category, and hold that line across agency outputs, partner communications, and platform narratives. Manage PR agencies with clear briefs and a high bar for output. Work closely with Content Acquisitions, Brand, Social, and Programming teams to ensure PR planning is integrated from the start rather than the end. Handle international studio relationships on all PR matters including approvals, asset access, and co-promotional alignment within partnership terms. Track coverage quality and category share of voice Skills and Attributes for Success: 10-12 years of experience in entertainment or media PR, with a meaningful portion of that spent working on premium or international content. Established relationships across the publications and journalists who set the agenda for entertainment and culture coverage in India. Comfortable working independently and making decisions without a detailed playbook. Strong written communication skills with the ability to craft press materials and internal briefs that are sharp and clear. Familiarity with the international streaming landscape and how global IP travels across markets. Able to manage multiple stakeholders across functions and geographies without losing sight of priorities. A genuine interest in international content and the confidence to have a point of view on it, not just facilitate coverage of it. title: Manager Analytics
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As an Manager
- Analytics, you'll be responsible for driving data-driven projects, designing complex data solutions, providing valuable insights to stakeholders and contributing to the growth of our Ads product and business metrics. About the team: The Central Analytics team is embedded within various business & product teams in a matrix structure to be a thought partner and provide comprehensive data insights to drive strategic decisions. This team is the strategic enabler for Jio Hotstar’s Ads business and product functions. In a world where consumers have endless entertainment choices, we help decode who they are, what they like and how they are relevant to Jio Hotstar Advertisers. At the core, we analyze consumer experience, consumer supply, advertisers demand, and our Ad serving capabilities to achieve goals (KPIs) across Ads product, Advertisers objectives, and Ads business planning. We design and leverage experiments, apply Gen AI for innovative problem-solving, and build analytical frameworks that guide key decisions. Our goal: to keep teams sharp, informed, and focused on the KPIs and drivers that truly matter. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and maintain foundational frameworks and shared components for Android Apply the analytics knowledge/skills in problem-solving and deliver actionable insights Generate and deliver quality data insights by creating reports, dashboards, and structured documented formats or summaries using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and other analytics platforms Develop a deep understanding of the data platform, technology stack, and ETL processes to ensure accurate analysis and reporting Utilize statistical techniques to validate findings and draw meaningful conclusions Communicate complex data concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities, support strategic decisions, and drive growth through predictive modeling and analysis Manage projects end-to-end, write efficient queries, and optimize performance through A/B testing and solution design Contribute data-driven insights in experiments and help build a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement Establish and mentor a team of product analysts Skills and attributes for success: Demonstrate expertise in predictive analysis, with a strong command of R, SQL, Python, Pyspark Familiarity with working with big data platforms and tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Hive) is preferred Experience in dashboard building and data visualization using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms is a strong plus Possess advanced technical skills and the ability to collect, organize, and disseminate information accurately Familiar with digital analytics and clickstream data Strong communicator with the ability to present complex insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences A passion for the entertainment industry and a strong understanding of online video streaming platforms (a plus) Experience in Adtech and OTT platforms is preferred Preferred education and experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Operational Research, Statistics, Physics, or a related technical discipline, with 7-10 years of experience in Business/Product Analytics, preferably from consumer technology companies title: Manager - Platform Marketing, Digital
jobDescription: Location: Mumbai (preferable)/ Bangalore About the Role Jio Hotstar is seeking a high-caliber, strategic thinker to lead our pioneering Content Commerce ecosystem. Content commerce is our vision to bring digital entertainment and instant shopping together. Instead of making users leave the app to buy something, we are building a seamless experience where they can interact and make purchases—like ordering food—directly within the Jio Hotstar interface while watching their favorite content. Note: Want to see what we are building? Check out "The Swiggy-Jio Hotstar Story" on the Swiggy Bytes blog to see how we are changing the game. As the Manager for Content Commerce, you will be the central owner driving user adoption, engagement, and business growth for these integrated experiences. What You Will Do Drive User Growth & Adoption: Design the strategy for how and when we prompt users to buy products during live events or shows. You will decide the best ways to grab user attention without disrupting their viewing experience. Own the Conversion Funnel: Monitor the daily numbers and the entire user journey—from the moment someone watches a video to the final checkout. You will identify where users drop off and run experiments to improve conversion rates. Design Rewards & Engagement Programs: Create and manage reward campaigns (like user giveaways and special offers) to motivate users to try the feature and build a habit of purchasing on the platform. Partner with Product & Tech Teams: Act as the voice of the consumer. Work closely with product managers and engineers to fix user experience (UX) issues, remove bugs, and simplify the checkout process. Build Scale Playbooks: Create clear, repeatable templates and playbooks so that we can quickly launch and scale similar commerce partnerships with other major brands in the future. What We Are Looking For Experience: 5-6 years of professional experience, with a proven track record of managing growth, strategy, or operations in fast-paced digital businesses. Commerce Background (Preferred): Extensive experience working inside leading e-commerce platforms, quick-commerce networks, digital marketplaces or retail experiences.. You must deeply understand transactional user behavior, checkout funnels, and customer retention strategies. Educational (Preferred): An undergraduate degree from premier engineering institutions combined with an MBA from a good business school Problem-Solving Mindset: A highly analytical thinker who relies on data to make decisions, test hypotheses, and solve ambiguous problems from first principles. Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead cross-functional projects and align Product, Tech, and Business teams toward a common goal. Our Culture & Benefits Our Culture: We are customer-obsessed, audacious in our vision, and encourage open dialogue. We believe trust and accountability go hand-in-hand, and we invest heavily in each other's growth. Perks: Unlimited leave, a progressive work-life philosophy, no dress code, and a front-row seat on our rocket ship to redefine the future of entertainment and commerce! Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, Jio Star is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. Jio Star India Private Limited (formerly known as Star India Private Limited) is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected.

title: Software Development Engineer II
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As a Software Development Engineer II – Android, you will be responsible for crafting performant and resilient Android applications, coupled with Android frameworks and APIs, and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.You will play a critical role in improving app performance and stability while shipping core capabilities that enhance the foundational platform. If you are a motivated individual with strong problem-solving skills and a desire to innovate in the mobile space, we want to hear from you! About the team: Content Commerce is a new and high-impact bet for Jio Hotstar. The team will build the technology that powers commerce experiences across Jio Hotstar’s content surfaces. The platform will bring together content understanding, product catalogues, contextual recommendations, interactive placements, transaction journeys, attribution, and partner integrations. It will support experiences ranging from products featured within entertainment content to merchandise, brand activations, and contextual commerce during live sports. Reporting To: Engineering Manager Key

title: Staff Product Designer
jobDescription:
Location: Onsite, Bangalore Work Type: Full time Job Summary: As a Staff Product Designer within our product design team, you will play a crucial role in enhancing the product experience for Jio Hotstar customers. Leveraging your full range of interaction, visual, and product-thinking skills, you will lead and own product features. Collaboration with cross-functional teams dedicated to revolutionizing entertainment and storytelling will be key to delivering engaging and inclusive experiences for our users ABOUT THE TEAM: Design is integral to shaping the user experience at Jio Hotstar. We have 4 key areas of focus
- Product Design, UX Research, Design Standards and Creative Studio. We are a closely-knit team of 30+ people at the moment, who work across the spectrum of design from deriving insight from data, designing interfaces and prototypes, and testing with users to motion graphics and illustrations. Key responsibilities ● Lead the design of new products, interfaces, and user experiences across multiple platforms ● Utilize user behavior insights and feedback to iteratively refine designs, ensuring continuous optimization and enhancement of user experiences ● Employ storytelling to articulate a vision that fosters a shared understanding of the UX strategy across the broader team ● Apply strategic thinking to translate ambiguous opportunities into clear, actionable roadmaps. ● Cultivate a culture of collaboration and creativity, providing mentorship and support to promote the professional growth of the design team ● Collaborate with Product Designers and Product Managers to define problem statements and develop project execution plans ● Work closely with engineers and product managers throughout the design process, from concept to production, to create user flows, build UI mockups, and develop prototypes Skills and attributes for success: ● An accomplished designer with a keen eye for quality design aesthetics, demonstrating a deep understanding of user experience and design principles that drive engagement and revenue growth ● Proficiency in translating abstract business concepts or requirements into tangible conceptual designs ● Exceptional design skills and a strong grasp of fundamental design disciplines (typography, composition, iconography, color, layouts, etc.), along with meticulous attention to detail ● Expertise in current best practices, developments, and trends across mobile and web platforms ● Ability to confidently articulate UX design rationale and lead conversations with teams and key stakeholders ● Experience in independently leading complex projects under tight timelines Preferred education and experience: ● Bachelors/Masters degree or equivalent in Design preferred. Overall 6-9 years of experience in the Design field as a Product Designer/Staff PD. title: Staff Product Manager - Search
jobDescription:
Location: Onsite, Bangalore Work Type: Full time Job Summary: As a Staff Product Manager for Jio Hotstar’s Search, you'll work closely with senior product and engineering peers to shape a product strategy that drives measurable improvements in query understanding, ranking, search personalisation, cold start and content discovery across Jio Hotstar's 500M+ user base. You will own the core search experience end-to-end
- from the search zero page, query understanding, ranking to results presentation and query-assist surfaces (pills, suggestions, spell-correct). Drawing on data, experimentation, and deep NLP/ML product instincts, you will identify gaps in query coverage and relevance, translate them into clear product requirements, and work with ML and engineering to ship improvements that move search success and engagement metrics at scale. About the Team: At Jio Hotstar, we're on a mission to deliver delightful experiences to our 500+ million customers across the globe. Our technology spans multiple countries. The Search team sits within the Viewer Experience org and is responsible for helping every user find exactly what they're looking for through a state-of-the-art search experience. We blend world-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a fast, relevant search experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building intelligent search and query-understanding systems that measurably improve how hundreds of millions of users discover content, join us in shaping the future of content discovery. Key responsibilities Conduct thorough research and analysis on query logs, search relevance, and content discovery gaps to generate actionable insights and determine ROI of search investments. Translate abstract problem statements into clear requirements by assessing query intent, retrieval & ranking model performance, and catalog coverage. Own and evolve the query understanding, search ranking & relevance roadmap, and influence roadmaps within and outside the Search team to enhance the broader discovery ecosystem, including integrating Search insights with Recommendations. . Collaborate effectively with ML Engineering, Data Science, and Platform teams, contributing to roadmaps and prioritisation decisions beyond in the search domain. Show agility in responding to external signals like content launches, live sports events, and seasonal shifts, enabling swift roadmap adjustments and ensuring transparent communication of downstream impacts on search quality. Take ownership of key KPIs that directly aligns with Organisation Objectives and Key Results. Develop deep expertise & drive strategic advancements through innovation and transformation. Skills and attributes for success: Communicate clearly and effectively, with precise articulation and logical progression of ideas, equally comfortable writing ML-facing product requirements and presenting search strategy to senior leadership. Apply structured frameworks and logical thinking to address complex query-understanding problems, asking the right questions to determine whether an issue is rooted in data quality, model behaviour, or product definition. Demonstrate the ability to bridge business problems and ML solutions, translating user and product goals into well-scoped problem formulations, and conversely, grounding algorithmic improvements in measurable business or user outcomes. Demonstrate sufficient understanding of ML and NLP fundamentals, including how ranking and query-understanding models are trained, evaluated, and deployed, to have substantive technical conversations with Data Scientists and ML Engineers, challenge assumptions, and make informed prioritisation decisions. Leverage a data-driven mindset to derive insights from query logs and metrics and make well-informed product decisions. Show strong user empathy, using structured problem-solving to address pain points across various user cohorts through hypothesis-building and solution development. Have a strong customer experience understanding to build and shape what the Search experience looks like for users across Mobile and Large Screen devices. Benchmark competitors and validate findings through experimentation, maintaining high standards for product roadmap inclusion. Confidently tackle ambiguous problems with minimal supervision, taking decisive action across the organization. Communicate clearly and effectively, with precise articulation and logical progression of ideas, equally comfortable writing ML-facing product requirements and presenting recommendation strategy to senior leadership Apply structured frameworks and logical thinking to address complex personalisation problems, asking the right questions to determine whether an issue is rooted in data quality, model behaviour, or product definition Demonstrate the ability to bridge business problems and ML solutions, translating user and product goals into well-scoped ML problem formulations, and conversely, grounding algorithmic improvements in measurable business or user outcomes Demonstrate sufficient understanding of ML fundamentals, including how recommendation models are trained, evaluated, and deployed, to have substantive technical conversations with Data Scientists and ML Engineers, challenge assumptions, and make informed prioritisation decisions Preferred education and experience: Bachelors/Masters degree or equivalent preferred. Minimum 7+ years of experience with at least 5 years of experience in product management At least 2 years owning ML / search / recommendation products at consumer scale, with a demonstrable track record of shipping measurable metric improvements, not just features. Fluency in the ML product lifecycle: feature engineering, A/B experiment design, metric interpretation, and launch readiness is a bonus. title: Product Designer - Design Systems
jobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY: As a Product Designer for Design Systems with a strong design engineering mindset, you will collaborate closely with designers, engineers, researchers, and cross-functional stakeholders to build and scale a cohesive Design Language System for millions of users. This role involves creating and maintaining high-quality components, patterns, and guidelines that drive consistency and efficiency across product experiences, while also contributing to the technical implementation of the system. You will define frameworks and governance to enable teams to effectively leverage the design system, continuously identifying opportunities to expand and improve it. A key aspect of this role is leveraging AI as a core capability — using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and other emerging technologies to prototype, automate workflows, and build scalable solutions faster. Your work will play a critical role in elevating design quality, bridging design and engineering, and shaping how modern tooling and AI can enhance the way products are designed and built across Jio Hotstar’s mobile, web, and TV platforms. ABOUT THE TEAM: Design is one of the key teams at Jio Hotstar. We have 3 key areas of focus
- Product Design, UX Research and Design Standards. We are a closely-knit team of 30+ people at the moment, who work across the spectrum of design from deriving insight from data, designing interfaces and prototypes, and testing with users to motion graphics and illustrations. We’re looking for someone who thinks beyond traditional design roles — combining systems thinking, design craft, and AI-powered building capabilities. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Co-own the Design Language System and drive its evolution and adoption to ensure high-quality, consistent product experiences Collaborate closely with designers, engineers, researchers, and cross-functional stakeholders to improve how teams design and build day-to-day Design, build, and document components, patterns, libraries, and guidelines that enable scalable and consistent experiences Define and implement frameworks, processes, and governance models to maximize effective usage of the Design System Partner with designers and engineers to identify gaps, solve system-level challenges, and scale the system for long-term sustainability Act as a strong advocate for design systems, driving awareness and adoption across the organization Leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, and similar) to prototype, automate workflows, and accelerate design system development Bridge design and engineering by building lightweight tools, scripts, or prototypes that improve efficiency and system adoption Explore and integrate emerging AI workflows to enhance how design systems are created, maintained, and scaled Identify and implement opportunities to reduce manual effort through automation, improving speed, quality, and consistency SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS: Proven ability to collaborate deeply with Design, Engineering, and cross-functional partners to build impactful design systems and tooling Strong design craft with a keen eye for detail and a solid foundation in typography, composition, color, layout, and interaction design Systems thinking mindset — ability to design holistically rather than focusing on one-off solutions High proficiency in Figma, with working knowledge of Git and modern front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, Java Script or similar frameworks) Inclination toward design engineering, with the ability to translate design concepts into functional prototypes or code Proactive approach to leveraging AI as a core skill for building, problem-solving, and accelerating workflows Hands-on experience or strong interest in AI-assisted tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and modern development workflows Comfort experimenting with emerging technologies and continuously evolving ways of working Ability to build lightweight tools, automations, or plugins to improve team efficiency and workflows Understanding of title: Staff Product Manager (Recommendations)
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As a Staff Product Manager for Recommendations, you’ll work closely with senior product and engineering peers to shape a product strategy that drives measurable improvements in content discovery and user engagement across Jio Hotstar’s 500M+ user base. You will own the recommendation surfaces that define what users see the moment they open the app, spanning personalised, ML-powered recommendations as well as popularity-based and contextual content surfaces. Drawing on data, experimentation, and deep ML product instincts, you will identify gaps in personalisation quality, translate them into clear product requirements, and work with ML and engineering to ship improvements that move retention and engagement metrics at scale. About the Team: At Jio Hotstar, we’re on a mission to deliver delightful experiences to our 500+ million customers across the globe. Our technology spans 25+ countries, with more on the horizon. The Recommendations & Personalisation (P13N) team sits within the Viewer Experience org and is responsible for deciding what content each user sees across every surface of the platform. We blend world-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalised, and engaging streaming experience at massive scale. If you’re passionate about building intelligent, performant recommendation systems that measurably improve how hundreds of millions of users discover content, join us in shaping the future of streaming. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Conduct thorough research and analysis on recommendation quality, user engagement patterns, and content discovery gaps to generate actionable insights and determine ROI of personalisation investments. Translate abstract problem statements into clear requirements by assessing user behaviour signals, model performance, and content catalogue dynamics. Influence roadmaps within and outside the Recommendations team to enhance the broader personalisation ecosystem, including integrations with Search, Watch Experience, and Growth. Collaborate effectively with ML Engineering, Data Science, and Platform teams, contributing to roadmaps and prioritisation decisions beyond the immediate recommendations domain Show agility in responding to external signals like content launches, live sports events, seasonal shifts, enabling swift roadmap adjustments and ensuring transparent communication of downstream impacts on recommendation quality. Take ownership of at least one key KPI that directly aligns with Product Objectives and Key Results Develop deep expertise in at least one functional area, driving strategic advancements through innovation and transformation Actively participate in team-building initiatives, including contributing to hiring processes Skills and attributes for success: Communicate clearly and effectively, with precise articulation and logical progression of ideas, equally comfortable writing ML-facing product requirements and presenting recommendation strategy to senior leadership Apply structured frameworks and logical thinking to address complex personalisation problems, asking the right questions to determine whether an issue is rooted in data quality, model behaviour, or product definition Demonstrate the ability to bridge business problems and ML solutions, translating user and product goals into well-scoped ML problem formulations, and conversely, grounding algorithmic improvements in measurable business or user outcomes Demonstrate sufficient understanding of ML fundamentals, including how recommendation models are trained, evaluated, and deployed, to have substantive technical conversations with Data Scientists and ML Engineers, challenge assumptions, and make informed prioritisation decisions Leverage a data-driven mindset to derive insights from metrics and make well-informed product decisions Show strong user empathy, using structured problem-solving to address pain points through hypothesis-building and solution development Benchmark competitors and validate findings through experimentation, maintaining high standards for product roadmap inclusion Confidently tackle ambiguous problems with minimal supervision, taking decisive action across the organization Foster a collaborative, respectful work environment, open to feedback, while mentoring junior PMs to success and effectively influencing without formal authority Preferred education and experience: Bachelors/Masters degree or equivalent preferred. Minimum 7+ years of experience with at least 5 years of experience in product management At least 2 years owning ML or recommendation products at consumer scale, with a demonstrable track record of shipping measurable metric improvements, not just features. Fluency in the ML product lifecycle: feature engineering, A/B experiment design, metric interpretation, and launch readiness Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, Jio Star is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. title: Senior Executive - Content Regulation (Telugu)
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Vet and review all short-form and long-form content (including acquired and original shows, films, promos, clips, commercials, and social media assets) from a content compliance and risk perspective. Proactively identify and flag potential violations of OTT and Broadcast compliance codes, internal policies, government and regulatory guidelines, and applicable legal frameworks. title: Assistant Manager - Partnerships, Sports
jobDescription: Job Summary Jio Star is India’s leading sports broadcaster, delivering world-class coverage of major sporting events including the IPL, ICC tournaments, Premier League, Pro Kabaddi and Wimbledon across multiple regional languages. With a mission to foster a multisport culture in India, Jio Star partners with key stakeholders to popularize sports beyond cricket. We are seeking a dynamic individual to join our Partnerships team to manage and expand partnerships across production houses, franchises, fan communities, influencers, music labels and talent agencies while driving strategic collaborations that power the next phase of Jio Star’s growth. Key Responsibilities Partnership Management: Build, nurture, and grow relationships with film production houses, franchisees, fan armies, influencers, talent agencies, sport bodies, and music labels to strengthen brand presence and drive value. Strategic Negotiations: Lead end-to-end partnership cycles — from developing business cases and creating impactful pitch decks to negotiating terms and closing contracts. Business Development: Proactively identify and secure new opportunities that align with Star Sports’ and Jio Hotstar’s long-term vision, driving sustained growth and innovation. Cross-Functional Coordination and Execution: Collaborate with marketing, content, sales, and operations teams across Jio Star to ensure smooth integration of partnerships into campaigns and initiatives. Performance & Growth: Define clear KPIs, monitor outcomes, and optimize partnership performance to deliver ROI, long-term brand equity, and measurable impact. jobDescription:
Location
- Onsite Work type
- Fulltime Job Summary About the team (Word limit
- 500 words advisable) Responsible for managing B2C subscription accounting for international entities, ensuring accurate revenue recognition, reconciliation of payment gateway transactions, compliance with tax requirements, and timely reporting to management. Reporting To
- Manager Key Responsibilities Manage accounting of B2C subscription invoices of Jio Hotstar of international entities. Ensure revenue completeness and accurate month-on-month recognition as per revenue schedules. Reconcile Invoice Register with Payment Gateway Settlement Reports to ensure completeness of B2C invoice and refund accounting. Apply receipts from payment gateways against outstanding invoices in a timely manner. Perform daily monitoring of subscription invoice counts across all locations to ensure accuracy and completeness. Reconcile payment gateway settlement reports with bank statements and investigate/report discrepancies, if any. Validate payment gateway charges through three-way reconciliation (Invoice Register, Settlement Report, and Agreement terms). Prepare and submit monthly tax reports in prescribed formats for all locations to support timely tax filings. Prepare and circulate monthly P&L and Balance Sheet schedules to management. Coordinate with payment gateway teams to resolve reconciliation and operational queries. Skills & Attributes for success Strong knowledge of revenue recognition principles Experience in reconciliation and payment gateway accounting Good understanding of indirect tax compliance Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Attention to detail and accuracy Preferred Education & Experience Postgraduate/Graduate in Finance Domain Experience in reconciliation and payment gateway accounting Proficiency in ERP system SAP and MS Excel About Us (Boilerplate) Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, Jio Star is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. title: Staff Software Development Engineer (Backend) - Viewer Experience
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the design and development of core backend systems that power large-scale, high-performance platforms. You’ll own complex projects end to end, operate with autonomy, and play a key role in shaping the architecture and future direction of high-throughput, low-latency systems. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive on solving challenging distributed systems problems and mentoring others toward engineering excellence. About the team: At Jio Hotstar, the Viewer Experience (VX) org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end-to-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalization, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. We blend world-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalized, and engaging OTT experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building immersive, intelligent, and performant user experiences that delight a billion users, join us in shaping the future of streaming. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and build scalable, fault-tolerant backend systems that power Jio Star’s tech stack Own end-to-end delivery of complex backend projects, from technical design to deployment and monitoring Drive architectural decisions and influence long-term engineering strategy for the team Build systems with strong observability and monitoring, ensuring system health, uptime, and fast incident response. Continuously evaluate and adopt relevant technologies. Take ownership of operational excellence, including performance tuning, incident response, and root cause analysis Mentor junior engineers, conduct technical deep dives and code reviews, and foster a culture of knowledge sharing Skills and attributes for success: Proficiency in Java, Golang, or Python Experience designing and building distributed systems at scale Strong understanding of storage systems, query performance, and caching strategies Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), messaging systems (Kafka), and CI/CD pipelines Proven ability to work autonomously, prioritize tasks, and manage delivery timelines in fast-paced environments You are passionate about growing engineers and leading by example Curious about how advertising systems work and how to optimize them for user and business outcomes Preferred education and experience: Bachelors/master's in computer science or a related field with 6-9 years of development experience Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, Jio Star is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. title: Associate Director - Entertainment Pricing, Planning, Supply and Ad Products, Digital
jobDescription: Job Summary As Associate Director, Entertainment Ad Sales (PRS Team), you will lead high impact Ad product & Ad tech initiatives for the entertainment vertical. You will act as a bridge between sales, ad product, ad operations, and leadership to roll out new Ad offerings and enhance the features of existing offerings. You will identify new ad tech related opportunities to scale up monetization, pricing, packaging, and new format rollouts aligned with market needs and internal capacity. About the team The Entertainment PRS (Product, Revenue & Strategy) function plays a critical role in defining how we monetize Entertainment Content, package ad offerings, optimize yield, and introduce innovative new ad offerings to stay ahead in the market. We operate at the intersection of technology, product, and monetization, driving programs that can scale up revenue and make Jiohotstar Entertainment preferred destination for advertisers too. * Key Responsibilities Drive high impact ad product launches (e.g. new ad formats, targeting, ad experiences) Work with cross functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering, ad ops, BI) Influence roadmap priorities by aligning stakeholders on objectives and outcomes Coordinate with stakeholder teams to manage dependencies and ensure timely execution Partner with sales teams to sell packaged propositions, custom solutions, strategic deals and resolve teething tech issues Regularly communicate program updates, decisions, and risks to leadership concisely and visually Coordinate pilot launches, A/B testing, feedback loops, and scale rollout. * Skills & Attributes for success 5 to 8 years of experience in digital media, adtech, programmatic, or product / revenue / monetization roles. Hands on experience driving one or more of: ad product development, pricing & packaging, programmatic monetization, yield management, new ad formats. Deep understanding of the advertising ecosystem (DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, header bidding, private marketplaces, targeting). Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders (sales, product, engineering, Ad ops). Ability to think commercially and translate product levers into revenue impact. Excellent communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders. High ownership mindset, ability to operate in ambiguity, structured thinking. Preferred Education & Experience A Bachelor's/Master’s degree with a minimum of 5-8 years of experience. Experience in Product/Strategy/Program roles in OTT/Media/Adtech is a must. title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Golang
jobDescription:
Job Summary: Our engineering team defines the technical architecture and drives itself to build systems that serve billions of requests per day, cosmic scales of video content streamed every day, with ultra-low latency design and high reliability. We make sure every byte of video content gets to millions of viewers, at the highest quality possible. title: Staff Software Development Engineer (Video Engineering)
jobDescription:

You will uphold a standard of excellence, ensuring high-quality work and timely delivery of projects. efficiency augmentation with video intelligence capabilities Build automated video quality control systems for incoming source content and encoded Jio Hotstar streams Drive technical implementation of media features in live streaming workflows with observability and resiliency Champion support for state-of-the-art media features on the platform, ensuring delightful user experience Collaborate with research and product teams to evaluate and integrate next-generation video technologies Skills and attributes for success: 6+ years of experience in multimedia software development with excellent problem-solving and debugging skills Expert proficiency in C++ or Java with strong object-oriented programming fundamentals Deep understanding of audio and video compression and processing, including: title: Engineering Manager - GenAI studios
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As an Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for leading the engineering team tasked with the development of an AI-native product designed for professional creators. The product's objective is to empower professional creators to direct and produce high-quality, production-grade, AI-generated content, with a particular emphasis on automated evaluations and validations. About the team: At Jio Hotstar, the Gen AI studios is an AI native, agile & fast-moving team focused on turning bold ideas into impactful products. From rapid prototyping of new concepts to building scalable platforms that power future growth, we thrive on experimentation and innovation. Our platform highlights creators and their narratives by giving them AI-powered systems using advanced machine learning and multimedia pipelines. As part of this team, you’ll work at the intersection of creativity and technology — building end-to-end experiences, experimenting with emerging tech, and shaping the future of entertainment content. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead and scale the Gen AI engineering team, responsible for developing and delivering high-quality features for AI content production Partner closely with Product, and Data Science teams to define and drive and deliver the tech roadmap items Design backend systems that scale across multiple frontier models Champion engineering excellence across observability, performance tuning, cost efficiency, and resilience engineering. Foster a high-ownership engineering culture focused on data-driven decision making, experimentation velocity, and customer-first thinking. Create effective mechanisms to set goals for the team, create execution plans and track progress against those. You'll collaborate with other Developers, Program Managers, and tech support teams, in an agile environment to estimate and deliver objectives set together as a team. title: Director - Technical Program Management
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As a Director – Technical Program Manager, you will lead large-scale, cross-functional technical programs that are critical to Jio Star's product and engineering roadmap. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Business leaders to drive execution, align priorities, mitigate risks, and ensure predictable delivery of complex initiatives. You will own end-to-end program execution, influence technical and business decisions, establish scalable program management practices, and foster collaboration across multiple teams. Your ability to balance strategic thinking with operational excellence will be key to delivering impactful outcomes. About The Team: Jio Hotstar is building the advertising platform that will power commerce-led advertising across some of India’s largest digital consumer businesses.This team sits at the intersection of Ad Tech, e-commerce, data, and monetisation. The goal is to help retail platforms unlock high-intent advertising inventory across the full shopping journey
- home pages, category pages, product detail pages, cart, order confirmation flows, and personalised placements
- while giving advertisers measurable outcomes. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead the planning and execution of complex cross-functional technical programs spanning multiple Product and Engineering teams. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to define program goals, execution plans, milestones, and success metrics. Drive roadmap alignment and ensure timely execution of strategic initiatives while balancing competing priorities. Identify technical and program risks early, drive mitigation plans, and communicate progress effectively to stakeholders. Facilitate decision-making across teams by bringing clarity to technical and business trade-offs. Collaborate closely with engineering teams to understand technical architecture, dependencies, and implementation challenges. Build strong relationships across the organization and influence without direct authority. Establish and continuously improve program management processes, governance models, and operational best practices. Track execution using measurable metrics and provide regular updates to senior leadership. Mentor and coach Technical Program Managers while promoting operational excellence across the organization. SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS: Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and modern engineering practices. Proven ability to manage multiple complex technical programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, and Business teams. Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system architecture, technical risks, and engineering trade-offs. Excellent program planning, execution, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated experience driving large-scale initiatives from conception through successful delivery. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured approach to execution. title: Software Development Engineer II - Fullstack
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As a Software Development Engineer II, you’ll build a world-class platform for our customers by solving complex technical problems and building systems that run at scale. You will play a critical role in developing code and solving problems independently while shaping our next-gen solutions that drive our company's mission forward. We seek candidates with a passion for crafting elegant code and building innovative software solutions. About the team: At Jio Hotstar, Gen AI studios is an AI native, agile & fast-moving team focused on turning bold ideas into impactful features for professional film making products. From rapid prototyping of new concepts to building scalable platforms that power future growth, we thrive on experimentation and innovation. Our platform highlights creators and their narratives by giving them AI-powered systems using advanced machine learning and multimedia pipelines. As part of this team, you’ll work at the intersection of creativity and technology — building end-to-end experiences, experimenting with emerging tech, and shaping the future of entertainment content. title: Vice President - Legal and Regulatory
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strategy & Operations: Own end-to-end execution of Jio Star's anti-piracy strategy across broadcast, OTT, IPTV, social media and emerging ecosystems. Define the function's operating model, KPIs and business-impact metrics — moving beyond volume-based takedown counts. Lead international expansion planning: jurisdictional scoping, coalition partnerships, and phased capability build-out. Platform Partnerships & Escalation: Own senior relationships with Meta, Google/You Tube, Telegram, ISPs, hosting providers, registrars and CDNs. Lead escalation pathways for high-priority takedowns, repeat-offender action and live-event enforcement. Represent Jio Star in industry coalitions and platform trust & safety forums (ACE, IBCAP, AAPA and equivalents). Live-Event Anti-Piracy Operations: Command the live-event anti-piracy operation for IPL, ICC and premium events — 24/7 control-room oversight, mobilization within hours. Establish playbooks for restream takedowns, app-store enforcement and ISP-level blocking during marquee fixtures. Intelligence, Investigations & Vendor Governance: Oversee the Intelligence & Investigations and the Data, Automation & Vendor Governance portfolio; ensure intelligence precedes every enforcement action. Govern the external vendor ecosystem: set SLAs, manage performance, rationalize the partner footprint and drive automation. Law Enforcement, Legal & Regional Coordination: Build senior relationships with national and state law enforcement, cyber cells, and MIB. Direct Regional Enforcement Coordinators on field operations, raids and state-level piracy disruption. Partner with in-house Legal on orders, dynamic injunctions, site-blocking and criminal complaints. Executive Engagement: Drive cross-functional coordination with Business, Legal, Distribution, Content Operations and Technology. Deliver executive reporting on threat landscape, enforcement outcomes and business impact to senior leadership. Required Experience & Capabilities: 15+ years in OTT, digital media, broadcasting or Trust & Safety, with a meaningful share in content protection, anti-piracy, fraud or platform integrity. Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder enforcement programs at scale across digital, broadcast and physical distribution. Direct engagement with Meta, Google/You Tube, Telegram, ISPs and hosting providers at a senior governance level. Deep, current understanding of digital piracy ecosystems — illegal IPTV networks, restream chains, Telegram piracy, cyberlockers and app-based modalities. Intelligence orientation — approaches problems as an investigator, not an operator; comfortable with attribution analysis and OSINT outputs. Systems thinking, platform ecosystem fluency, operational maturity and strong stakeholder management at executive, regulatory and law-enforcement levels. Live-event content protection operations experience strongly preferred. Alternative Backgrounds Considered: Jio Star will actively consider Ex-Armed Forces SSC officers (Indian Navy / Air Force) from Signals, Intelligence, Cyber or Information Warfare backgrounds with demonstrable platform-ecosystem fluency. title: Staff Software Development Engineer
jobDescription:
Location: Onsite, Bangalore Work Type: Full time Job Summary: As a Staff Engineer, you will lead the design and development of core systems that drive Jio Star’s advertising capabilities
- from ad delivery and targeting to measurement and optimization. You’ll own large-scale projects end to end, operate with autonomy, and play a key role in shaping the architecture and future direction of our high-throughput, low-latency systems. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive on solving hard distributed systems problems and mentoring others toward engineering excellence. About the Team: Jio Hotstar is building the advertising platform that will power commerce-led advertising across some of India’s largest digital consumer businesses.This team sits at the intersection of Ad Tech, e-commerce, data, and monetisation. The goal is to help retail platforms unlock high-intent advertising inventory across the full shopping journey
- home pages, category pages, product detail pages, cart, order confirmation flows, and personalised placements
- while giving advertisers measurable outcomes. Key responsibilities ● Design and build scalable, resilient microservices that power Jio Star’s ad tech stack ● Own end-to-end delivery of complex backend projects, from technical design to deployment and monitoring ● Write high-quality, maintainable code, and ensure rigorous testing and fault tolerance ● Drive architectural decisions and influence long-term engineering strategy for the team ● Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into tech solutions ● Take ownership of operational excellence, including performance tuning, incident response, and root cause analysis ● Mentor junior engineers, conduct technical deep dives and code reviews, and foster a culture of knowledge sharing Skills and attributes for success: ● Proficiency in Java, Golang, or Python ● Experience designing and building distributed systems at scale ● Strong understanding of storage systems, query performance, and caching strategies ● Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), messaging systems (Kafka), and CI/CD pipelines ● Proven ability to work autonomously, prioritize tasks, and manage delivery timelines in fast-paced environments ● You are passionate about growing engineers and leading by example ● Curious about how advertising systems work and how to optimize them for user and business outcomes Preferred education and experience: ● Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or a related field with 6-9 years of experience in backend development About Jio Star Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, Jio Star is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. title: Senior Software Development Engineer Test II
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As a Senior Software Development Engineer Test II, you'll design and build the test systems that ensure quality for a massive user base. Drive automation to enable hands-free releases, creating scalable frameworks to handle thousands of daily tests. Partner with Product, UX, and Development, to deliver an awesome entertainment experience to 300+ million users. About the team: The QE team crafts cutting-edge test solutions to enable rapid, high-quality releases. We build automation frameworks, test data engines, orchestrators, and simulators that scale across our apps, middleware, and microservices. Partnering closely with Quality, Dev Ops, and development teams, we drive our shift-left testing strategy to ensure a world-class user experience! Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
You will build highly scalable test frameworks, systems, and infrastructure that can scale to thousands of tests per day You will contribute to making tests automation results supremely reliable and trustable to the extent of enabling hands-free releases You will contribute in an individual capacity to deliver innovative solutions to complex test automation challenges You will work closely with Product, UX, and Development teams to execute and deliver with high quality on the vision, and roadmap to develop discovery experiences across Mobile, Web, and Living Room devices These experiences have to be highly performant, personalized, engaging and relevant to potentially 300+ million users You will be part of the Quality and Release team, which delivers a high quality app experience to customers in multiple countries to discover content across the thousands of titles available in various genres and languages Required skills & Attributes for Success: Excellent automation skills for Front end client applications like Mobile, TVs, Web, Set Top Boxes or Living Room devices. Experience with end-to-end testing ownership of one or more layers
- Services, Middleware, Apps in a Product based organization. Good understanding of the REST APIs, request-response structures, error and status codes. Experience in industry best practices in Software development processes: Unit testing, OOPS, design, code reviews etc. Hands on with github, linux commands, shell scripts and good knowledge on building and publishing POCs. Experience on Appium, XCUITest, Espresso, Jetpack Compose, or other Java Script automation frameworks. Should be able to handle delivering high quality products, with a focus on shift left and automated quality sign offs. Should have a problem solving attitude, and be open to challenging themself, to analyse, architect, and implement solutions to everyday problems that present themselves at “Jio Hot Star Scale”. Experience developing backend tools or frameworks to test Rest APIs, microservices, data migration, failover scenarios, blue green or canary deployment procedures. Ability to build distributed systems for performance and scale testing. Hands-on experience with App Store Management
- Google Play Store, Apple App Store, etc. Experience with AWS, GCP or similar cloud providers. About the team: At Jio Hotstar, Quality Engineering isn't just a job; it's a mission to deliver flawless streaming experiences to millions across the globe. Build cutting-edge automation frameworks, champion "shift-left" testing, and ensure our developers have the tools and confidence to release high-quality code, fast. We're not just big; we're growing. Tackle the unique challenges of testing at scale, from performance and reliability to compatibility across a diverse range of devices. We're investing in building reliable automation to cut down manual testing, ephemeral environments, and AI-driven testing. Be a pioneer in the evolution of Quality Engineering! Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Employ testing tools and frameworks to ensure efficient development, testing, and deployment lifecycles Responsible for Implementing end-to-end (E2E) automation tests using industry-standard frameworks Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation Work closely with developers, QA engineers, and product stakeholders to understand project requirements, user
