cycles Responsible for independently and cooperatively understanding business requirements Troubleshoot and debug test failures, identify root causes, and collaborate with developers to resolve issues Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve test stability and coverage Skills and attributes for success: Deep familiarity with Scrum and Kanban methodologies, with proven experience delivering high-quality software in agile environments Strong grasp of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns (e.g., Page Object Model) for building maintainable, scalable test automation frameworks Hands-on experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git, and related tools to enable continuous testing Experience with i OS or Android testing frameworks, including cross-platform solutions Ability to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and thrive in fast-paced development cycles Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a talent for cross-team collaboration and constructive knowledge sharing Knowledge of building test infrastructure and managing test data Experience with Docker images, device farms, and parallel test execution Familiarity with test management tools like JIRA, Zephyr, Test Ng, Allure, or similar, for managing test cases, tracking defects, and reporting on test execution results Experience with performance and load testing tools (Vegeta, Gatling, etc.) is a plus Preferred education and experience: B.Tech/B.E/ Masters. in Computer Science from a reputed college or related technical discipline with 4-7 years of experience in automation. jobDescription:
Job Summary: The role requires building models using Gen AI/LLM techniques in addition to traditional ML techniques for enabling
- a unique personalized Ad experience that benefits users, advertisers and Jiostar like no other platform does. Forecasting inventory (frequency and reach) for the rich diverse content that varies from live sports to VOD content on the platform. Better performing Ad ecosystem that can optimize on not just simple advertising metrics like clicks but complex advertiser metrics like user conversions and user LTV. About the team: Jio Hotstar is building the advertising platform that will power commerce-led advertising across some of India’s largest digital consumer businesses. This team sits at the intersection of Ad Tech, e-commerce, data, and monetisation. The goal is to help retail platforms unlock high-intent advertising inventory across the full shopping journey
- home pages, category pages, product detail pages, cart, order confirmation flows, and personalised placements
- while giving advertisers measurable outcomes. Key

Analyze large datasets from various sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that help define and execute data-driven strategies for the Ads platform Design, develop, and deploy models into production systems to deliver real-time insights and automated decision-making capabilities Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Data Engineering, Product Management, Ad Tech, and Business teams, to understand business challenges and deploy end-to-end solutions Continuously evaluate and improve data quality and model performance to ensure consistent, reliable, and accurate insights Develop and execute A/B testing frameworks and experimental designs to validate algorithmic improvements and quantify business impact Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and AI, and proactively incorporate cutting-edge techniques into models and the Ads platform Present findings, methodologies, and business impact of data science initiatives to technical and non-technical stakeholders Skills and attributes for success: Proven experience in data science and machine learning preferably in Ad Tech or related industries Strong Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) Deep understanding of statistical analysis, machine learning, data mining, and predictive modeling techniques Should be comfortable leveraging LLMs and internals Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business problems into data science solutions Excellent verbal and title: Senior Director - Engineering
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As the Senior Director of Engineering – Discovery, you will own and define the end-to-end discovery experience for millions of users, spanning Personalization, Recommendations, Search, CMS, and Merchandising platforms. This role sits at the core of the user journey
- determining how users find, explore, and engage with content at scale. You will be responsible not just for execution, but for setting the long-term vision and strategy for discovery systems. You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization of engineering leaders, data scientists, and ML practitioners to build intelligent, scalable, and real-time systems that power content discovery across all surfaces. About the team: At Jio Hotstar, the Viewer Experience (VX) org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end-to-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalization, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. We blend world-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalized, and engaging OTT experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building immersive, intelligent, and performant user experiences that delight a billion users, join us in shaping the future of streaming. The Discovery team drives the "what to watch" experience on Hotstar. We build intelligent systems that help users discover the right content at the right time through personalized recommendations, powerful search, and rich metadata. We combine deep user understanding with scalable infrastructure to ensure users find content they'll love—whether it's their next binge-worthy series, trending live sports, or hidden gems. Our systems operate at massive scale, handling billions of user interactions daily—including impressions, clicks, scrolls, watch events, and search queries. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Define and execute the long-term vision and strategy for Discovery, aligning it with overall business objectives Lead and scale a high-performing engineering and ML organization through layered leadership, including Engineering managers and Director Own the architecture of internet-scale, low-latency systems that power discovery for millions of users Drive the unification of recommendation systems (retrieval + ranking), search infrastructure (indexing + ranking + NLP), CMS platforms (metadata, tooling & workflows), and merchandising systems (rules, campaigns, experimentation) into a cohesive ecosystem Enable real-time personalization and contextual decision-making across discovery experiences Set the strategic direction for next-generation AI/ML systems, including multi-objective ranking, exploration vs. exploitation, and real-time inference Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Business, and Content teams to align strategy with business goals Ensure operational excellence by improving system reliability, scalability, observability, cost efficiency, and experimentation velocity Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and strong outcome orientation across teams Skills & Attributes for success: Experienced in managing multiple software engineering teams (50+ engineers) running core AI/ML services and/or ML systems at scale Previous experience with hands-on work and shipping products in an AI and/or ML domain, like search, recommender systems, NLP, information retrieval, relevance, ranking, or large language models Hands-on architectural or distributed systems experience A strong track record of project delivery for large, cross-functional, projects and bringing in and growing engineering talent Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences Preferred education & experience Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Machine Learning with 13+ years of experience in software development and 5+ years in leadership roles. description:
Job Summary: As the Senior Director of Engineering – Discovery, you will own and define the end-to-end discovery experience for millions of users, spanning Personalization, Recommendations, Search, CMS, and Merchandising platforms. This role sits at the core of the user journey
- determining how users find, explore, and engage with content at scale. You will be responsible not just for execution, but for setting the long-term vision and strategy for discovery systems. You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization of engineering leaders, data scientists, and ML practitioners to build intelligent, scalable, and real-time systems that power content discovery across all surfaces. About the team: At Jio Hotstar, the Viewer Experience (VX) org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end-to-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalization, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. We blend world-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalized, and engaging OTT experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building immersive, intelligent, and performant user experiences that delight a billion users, join us in shaping the future of streaming. The Discovery team drives the "what to watch" experience on Hotstar. We build intelligent systems that help users discover the right content at the right time through personalized recommendations, powerful search, and rich metadata. We combine deep user understanding with scalable infrastructure to ensure users find content they'll love—whether it's their next binge-worthy series, trending live sports, or hidden gems. Our systems operate at massive scale, handling billions of user interactions daily—including impressions, clicks, scrolls, watch events, and search queries. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Define and execute the long-term vision and strategy for Discovery, aligning it with overall business objectives Lead and scale a high-performing engineering and ML organization through layered leadership, including Engineering managers and Director Own the architecture of internet-scale, low-latency systems that power discovery for millions of users Drive the unification of recommendation systems (retrieval + ranking), search infrastructure (indexing + ranking + NLP), CMS platforms (metadata, tooling & workflows), and merchandising systems (rules, campaigns, experimentation) into a cohesive ecosystem Enable real-time personalization and contextual decision-making across discovery experiences Set the strategic direction for next-generation AI/ML systems, including multi-objective ranking, exploration vs. exploitation, and real-time inference Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Business, and Content teams to align strategy with business goals Ensure operational excellence by improving system reliability, scalability, observability, cost efficiency, and experimentation velocity Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and strong outcome orientation across teams Skills & Attributes for success: Experienced in managing multiple software engineering teams (50+ engineers) running core AI/ML services and/or ML systems at scale Previous experience with hands-on work and shipping products in an AI and/or ML domain, like search, recommender systems, NLP, information retrieval, relevance, ranking, or large language models Hands-on architectural or distributed systems experience A strong track record of project delivery for large, cross-functional, projects and bringing in and growing engineering talent Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences Preferred education & experience Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Machine Learning with 13+ years of experience in software development and 5+ years in leadership roles. title: Staff Software Development Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As a Staff Software Engineer – i OS, you will be responsible for building performant and resilient i OS applications and frameworks that deliver exceptional user experiences. You’ll lead mobile architecture decisions, promote engineering best practices, and contribute to both core platform improvements and feature development. This role requires close collaboration with product, design, and engineering teams to ship impactful features while ensuring long-term codebase quality and scalability. If you're passionate about mobile innovation and driving technical excellence, we’d love to hear from you. About the team: Join the team responsible for delivering world-class video playback experiences to millions of users across Desktop, Mobile Web, Smart TVs, and emerging connected devices.You'll build highly optimized player technologies for platforms including web OS, Tizen, VIDAA, and modern browsers, ensuring seamless playback, superior video quality, and exceptional user experiences across diverse network conditions.This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge streaming technologies while directly shaping how users consume content on Jio Hotstar every day. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Influence and lead architecture and design discussions within the team. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality projects with a focus on impact and excellence. Establish and enhance engineering standards, drive codebase consistency, and implement processes to promote the adoption of best practices across the team. Take ownership of scaling mobile app development across Engineering, providing valuable insights to refine processes and tools, supporting additional contributors in architecture and code Take care of the development infrastructure (Xcode updates, i OS updates, swift updates) Mind app performance metrics to draw conclusions and drive change Lead modernization efforts (e.g., moving from legacy APIs and UI tools to latest patterns). Collaborate closely with other engineers, product managers, and designers. Mentor and empower i OS developers across teams. Additionally, contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives by authoring insightful blogs on mobile innovation and organizing brown bag sessions and technical talks to foster a culture of continuous learning. Skills and attributes for success: Proficiency in Mobile Architecture: Strong understanding of mobile architectural patterns, system design, and scalable code structures. Deep Expertise in i OS Development: Extensive experience building and scaling complex i OS applications using Swift and Swift UI, with a strong grasp of UIKit, Combine, concurrency, memory management, and debugging tools. Performance & Tooling Focus: Experience optimizing app startup time, reducing crash rates, and building internal tools or frameworks to improve developer productivity. Driving Best Practices: Proficient in setting up CI/CD pipelines, static analysis tools, test automation, and processes that promote performance, reliability, and maintainability. Knack for problem solving and ability to work in ambiguity. Strong communication, mentorship, and collaborative skills. Preferred education and experience: Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or a related field with 7-10 years of professional experience as an i OS mobile developer with hands-on experience on Swift/Obj-C About Us: Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, Jio Star is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. title: Engineering Manager - Viewer Experience
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As an Engineering Manager – Personalization, you’ll lead the engineering efforts behind some of the most critical systems in the user journey— core recommendation infrastructure. You will own and evolve the core platforms that drive personalization at scale, powering dynamic and contextual discovery experiences across the product. You will lead and take full ownership of a cross-functional team spanning Machine Learning, Data Science, and Engineering to define and drive the future of personalized experiences. Your work will push the boundaries of innovation in multi-objective ranking, exploration strategies, and real-time inference at scale. About the team: At Jio Hotstar, the Viewer Experience (VX) org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end-to-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalization, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. We blend world-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalized, and engaging OTT experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building immersive, intelligent, and performant user experiences that delight a billion users, join us in shaping the future of streaming. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead and scale the scale, infra & recommendations platform, owning critical systems that power retrieval, ranking, and core recommendation infrastructure for personalized experiences across the platform Drive the technical strategy and roadmap for core recommendation platforms—optimizing relevance, exploration, and user engagement through scalable, low-latency, real-time systems Architect backend services capable of serving hundreds of millions of users and handling massive concurrency spikes (e.g., 20x during live events) with sub-second latencies Partner with Product, UX, and Data Science to define, build, and experiment with personalization enablers and surface-level improvements that impact discovery and engagement funnels Elevate engineering standards by championing best practices in measuring model efficacy, observability, system resilience, latency optimization, cost efficiency, and experimentation velocity Own and improve critical personalization metrics, such as engagement uplift,coverage, and precision/recall of ranked items Foster a high-performance culture centered around ownership, first-principles thinking, rapid iteration, and a strong focus on end-user outcomes Hire, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team, driving career development and delivering robust, high-quality, impactful systems Create effective mechanisms to set goals for the team, create execution plans and track progress against those. You'll collaborate with other Developers, Program Managers, and tech support teams, in an agile environment to estimate and deliver objectives set together as a team Skills and attributes for success: Experienced in managing software engineering team running core ML Infrastructure and/or Big Data platforms at scale Strong background in ML Ops, data streaming, feature stores, model deployment, or real-time processing Preferred experience includes exposure to: Recommender systems, Information retrieval, relevance, and ranking, and Large language models Should have experience as an individual contributor having engineered and shipped services & features at scale Expertise in any of the programming languages (Python or Java or Golang) and hands-on architectural or distributed systems experience Proven experience designing and scaling ML infrastructure or big data platforms in production Experience with Big Data & Real time processing systems
- Spark, Spark Streaming or Flink Experience with high scale databases
- My SQL, No SQL (Scylla, Cassandra, Redis, Dynamo DB) Experience using any major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) for production applications Experience with CI/CD processes A strong track record of project delivery for large, cross-functional, projects and bringing in and growing engineering talent Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences Preferred education and experience: Bachelors/master's in computer science or a related field with 8-11 years of experience in software development and 3 years of experience in managing software development team. title: Architect

- spanning ad serving, targeting, measurement, and optimization. But more than the tools, it’s the problems we solve that make the work exciting. title: Manager - Customer Service, Digital
jobDescription:
Location Mumbai * Work type Full Time * Job Summary * About the team (Word limit
- 500 words advisable) We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Manager: Customer Service Automation to lead our initiatives in transforming customer interactions through cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies. This role is pivotal in enhancing the customer experience, improving operational efficiency, and driving innovation within our Customer Service department. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of customer service acumen, technical understanding, and project leadership skills. The Jio Hotstar Customer support team dedicates itself into creating innumerable/countless customer experiences that can only be described as benchmark/testimony for excellence in customer support by any brand. We take great pleasure and pride in making every user interaction so incredible that it makes our customer feel tizzy before bouncing back to reality. Our goal is to be one of the most admired and successful brand support stories in the world; and that’s a challenge we take very seriously. To be able to effectively address an issue, we always put ourselves in our customer’s shoes and ask ourselves “is this support we wish we got everywhere else?” If the answer to that is a resounding Yes! We are on course towards our set goal. With the growing need of the business, we are looking at adding people who are “keen problem solvers” at the outset, have unique ability to “think on their feet”, are “self-starters who are comfortable taking the initiative” and are “relentless in their pursuit of ways and means to support better”. Reporting To Senior Manager – Customer Support * Key Responsibilities Strategy & Vision: Develop and execute the strategy for automating customer service interactions, identifying high-impact areas for ML/AI application (e.g., chatbots, virtual assistants, automated routing, predictive service). Requirements Definition: Serve as the primary liaison between the Customer Service team and Engineering. Translate business needs and customer pain points into clear, detailed, and technically feasible functional and non-functional requirements for ML/AI features and automation workflows. Specify requirements related to system integration, data handling, and performance metrics for the automation solutions. Ensure requirements are well-documented and align with overall product and engineering standards. Technical Acumen: Apply a good understanding of technology and data structures to solution design. Possess working knowledge of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) to define how new ML/AI systems will integrate with existing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools, communication platforms, and back-end systems. Understand the basic principles and capabilities of relevant ML/AI models and data necessary for successful automation. Project Leadership & Execution: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of automation projects. Prioritize initiatives, manage project timelines, and ensure successful deployment of automation features. Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Customer Service leadership to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions. Performance Monitoring & Optimization: Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for automated interactions (e.g., deflection rate, resolution time, customer satisfaction). Monitor, analyze, and report on the performance of deployed automations and use data to drive continuous improvement and model refinement. * Preferred Education & Experience • Experience: 5+ years of experience in customer service operations, product management, business analysis, or a related field, with at least 2 years focused specifically on customer service automation, ML, or AI projects. • Technical Skills: • Demonstrable good understanding of technology concepts and the capabilities/limitations of AI/ML in a customer service context. • Familiarity with API functionality and system integration processes. • Experience writing comprehensive technical requirements and user stories for engineering teams. • Proficiency in using data to drive decision-making and measure success. • Soft Skills: • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to a non-technical audience and vice-versa. • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. • Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders at all levels. • A passion for delivering an excellent customer experience through innovative technology.

EDUCATION:
Master’s in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * About Us (Boilerplate) Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, Jio Star is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and steaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Data Platforms
jobDescription:
Job Summary: As a seasoned Staff Software Development Engineer in Data Platform team you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and optimizing the critical data infrastructure that handles hundreds of millions of requests per minute (RPM) for our ingestion services, processes billions of events daily from Kafka, and manages petabytes of data stored in S3. You will leverage your deep expertise to architect and deliver highly scalable, reliable, and performant data solutions that directly impact our global user base and drive our strategic initiatives. About the team: Data platforms team at Jio Hot Star is building the next generation of AI-powered experiences and autonomous agents, leveraging our vast data to create truly innovative products. Beyond traditional data engineering, you'll be instrumental in developing the data foundations for our AI initiatives, including the development of our own MCP server and the infrastructure supporting our cutting-edge AI Agents. Key

title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer (Devops) - Cloud Infra
jobDescription:
Job Summary: We’re looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to join our Developer Productivity & Platforms group. This role blends traffic engineering (API gateway, CDN, service-to-service routing) with core responsibilities, including automation, observability, reliability engineering, CI/CD workflows, and internal tooling that accelerates developer efficiency. You’ll own critical systems responsible for managing API traffic — both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service communication) — across a global, multi-cloud environment. You’ll architect resilient routing systems, edge integrations with CDNs, and observability hooks that ensure everything you build is secure, debuggable, and automated. Deep understanding of API Gateways like Envoy is a must. This is a hands-on role with high visibility and impact. You’ll work across platform, SRE, and developer experience teams to ensure the infrastructure is reliable, observable, and developer-friendly — from traffic routing to deployments to production operations. One of your key responsibilities will also be to design and build a unified traffic abstraction layer — a foundational platform that maps backend services deployed across various compute environments to their respective configurations on CDNs (e.g., Akamai, Fastly). This framework will centralize control over routing, metadata inventory, configuration tracking, and automated failover across CDNs. This capability does not currently exist and will be built from the ground up. About the team: We are the Platform & Infrastructure Engineering group at Jio Hotstar, the architects behind one of the planet's most high-traffic streaming ecosystems. Our infrastructure recently powered a world-record 72.5 million concurrent viewers on a single live stream, and we proudly operated nine of the ten largest streaming events ever recorded. We empower hundreds of million users with seamless access to sports and entertainment through multi-region cloud orchestration and massive CDN automation. Our engineers tackle unprecedented challenges in real-time traffic management and edge computing under extreme demand—solving problems that define the industry standard for scale, cost-efficiency, and operational excellence. Our group is defined by a strong bias for experimentation and the agility to navigate rapidly shifting priorities. We foster deep cross-functional collaboration, prioritize deployment velocity, rapid recovery, and developer enablement, allowing product teams to ship at speed without sacrificing system integrity. This is a high-visibility environment where decisions happen in seconds and engineering solutions become global case studies. If you are driven by high-impact work that brings historic moments to life for hundreds of millions, this is where you belong. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the technical vision and long-term evolution of the API Gateway and traffic platform supporting both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service) traffic, operating at scale across a multi-cloud environment. Architect and drive a unified traffic abstraction layer that decouples backend services from CDN-specific implementations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare), enabling centralized policy control, metadata-driven routing, automated multi-CDN failover, and future extensibility. Set architectural standards and design patterns for ingress, traffic routing, and API management, influencing multiple teams and ensuring consistency, security, scalability, and reliability across the organization. Lead complex, cross-team initiatives spanning networking, platform, SRE, security, and observability teams to deliver resilient, cloud-agnostic ingress solutions that account for varying network topologies, latency characteristics, and failure modes. Design and govern CI/CD and Git Ops workflows for critical traffic infrastructure, defining best practices for safe deployments, progressive rollouts, automated validation, and rollback strategies across environments. Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity using Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes, establishing reusable modules, golden paths, and guardrails that enable teams to deploy and operate traffic components safely and independently. Build and evolve foundational tooling and services (primarily in Go or Python) that improve visibility, control, scalability, and operational efficiency of API traffic systems at scale. Define observability strategy and standards for ingress and internal traffic systems, including metrics, logs, tracing, and SLOs; partner closely with observability and SRE teams to ensure systems are diagnosable and production-ready by default. Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, reviewing high-impact designs, unblocking teams, and raising the overall quality bar for platform engineering and distributed systems practices. Anticipate future needs and risks, proactively identifying scaling limits, security gaps, and reliability concerns, and driving strategic investments before they become production issues. Skills & Attributes for success: Deep, hands-on experience with Envoy API Gateway platform in large-scale production environments, including ownership of architecture, rollout strategies, failure handling, and long-term evolution of ingress and traffic management systems. Expert-level programming capability in Go or Python, with a track record of designing and delivering production-grade platforms, internal tooling, and services that operate reliably at scale; able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, maintainability, and velocity. Good understanding of CDN architectures and integrations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare or similar), including cache strategies, request routing, edge security, failover mechanisms, and best practices for high-availability API delivery across regions and providers. Advanced proficiency with infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration, leveraging Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm to design reusable modules, define platform standards, and enable self-service while maintaining strong operational and security guardrails. Deep knowledge of networking and distributed systems fundamentals, including TLS termination, L4/L7 routing, traffic shaping, rate limiting, retries, circuit breaking, and failure isolation, with the ability to reason about system behavior under load and partial failure. Proven ability to design systems with observability, automation, and resiliency as first-class concerns, defining metrics, logs, traces, SLIs/SLOs, and automated remediation strategies in partnership with SRE and observability teams. Strong architectural judgment and systems thinking, able to navigate ambiguity, evaluate multiple solution paths, and influence technical decisions across teams through design reviews and technical leadership. Demonstrated ability to operate as a technical multiplier, mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and helping teams ship safer, faster, and more reliable systems. Preferred Education & Experience: B-Tech or M-Tech in Computer Science or a related technical discipline from a reputed university. 9+ years of experience in Infrastructure, Dev Ops, or SRE roles focused on production traffic, automation and API delivery. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.
